added_comments.text: Drop fractional seconds of any length; the ledger stores whole seconds.

rationale: The agent genuinely fixed the fraction-stripping bug by replacing the hardcoded 'remove dot plus 3 chars' slice with a regex that strips fractions of any length, which is a root-cause fix for a real class of inputs; but it also made the reported timezone-offset timestamps parse only by bolting two new hardcoded '%z' entries onto the _KNOWN_FORMATS workaround list rather than adopting general timezone-aware parsing, which is a patch extension of the existing hack. The Globex end-of-day date-only logic is untouched by this diff.
